谨慎模式按一周播放采样，满一周后把高于 6.5 分的歌下载到应用本地。实时模式边: Cautious mode samples a week of plays, then downloads tracks above 6.5 to app storage. Live mode caches while you listen and only this play counts: keep it at 60% (score 6), otherwise delete. Aggressive mode caches every track with no score; when full it drops the least-played; each week it clears tracks unheard for a week. Quality tiers are separate items. Not the Download folder. Turning off stops sampling and this cache playback.
